subject.title: [Bug] Agent context window fragmentation during concurrent subagent tool calls

question: Should concurrent native subagent completions preserve correlated completion order, or should OpenClaw re-present them in original spawn order?
rationale: Both behaviors are internally coherent, and spawn-order buffering trades deterministic presentation for delayed fast-child results and more complicated partial-failure handling.

options.title: Preserve completion order
options.body: Keep the upstream correlated completion model and require a failing trace before changing transcript semantics.

options.title: Present spawn order
options.body: Define a presentation-layer ordering policy, including timeout and failed-child behavior, without mutating canonical task correlation.

recommendation.title: Preserve completion order
recommendation.body: Keep the upstream correlated completion model and require a failing trace before changing transcript semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history-backed owner for the native Codex subagent task-mirroring boundary where the policy would be applied or rejected.
